page.overview:
What is Pollux Black?

Pollux Black (1912–1990) was a pure-blood wizard and a member of the noble House of Black. He was the eldest child of Cygnus Black (II) and Violetta Bulstrode and the older brother of Cassiopeia, Marius, and Dorea Black. He married Irma Crabbe and they had three children: Walburga, Alphard, and Cygnus.

The father of Cygnus and Walburga, Pollux was respectively the paternal grandfather of Bellatrix Lestrange, Andromeda Tonks and Narcissa Malfoy and the maternal grandfather of Sirius and Regulus Black.

Like many members of the Black family, the name comes from a star. It is the brightest star in the constellation Gemini. The name refers to Castor and Pollux, the twin sons of Zeus and Leda in Greek mythology.

The name is traditionally thought to mean "much wine", since astrologers associate Pollux with prosperity and celebration with wine. Pollux's sister Cassiopeia was named after a constellation.
